name: knip
description: Find and fix unused files, dependencies, and exports in JavaScript and TypeScript projects; configure Knip through the official MCP server.

interface.shortDescription: Unused file, dependency, and export linting with MCP
interface.longDescription: Teach agents to run the Knip CLI accurately: find unused files, dependencies, and exports in JavaScript and TypeScript projects; choose production mode, workspaces, and issue-type filters; apply safe auto-fixes; and configure knip.json through the official @knip/mcp server (knip-configure, knip-run, knip-docs). Prefer documented flags and the published schema over guessed options, and review --fix diffs before committing.
defaultPrompt: Install the Knip MCP server and configure knip.json for this project
Run Knip and summarize unused files, exports, and dependencies
Run knip --production and propose safe --fix changes without deleting files
